role: The three creature attributes (UNDEFINED, UNDEAD, ARTHROPOD) that potion applicability and some mob behaviour dispatch on.
notes: living_creature_attribute is EntityLivingBase.getCreatureAttribute as the kinds override it (zombie and pigman, skeleton: UNDEAD; spider, cave spider, silverfish: ARTHROPOD). potion.c's potion_applicable_to still writes its UNDEAD refusals per kind.
